subject: MAP draft: target close & procurement signature deadline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fintechco.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft and target close alignment

Hi Alex  great call earlier today, thanks for walking through the pilot goals and success metrics. Per our discussion, attached is the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx) with proposed milestones, owners, and dependencies. High-level summary and asks below: 

Proposed target close: 2026-09-20 (pilot complete + contract signed)
Procurement/contract signature deadline: 2026-09-15 (to allow provisioning and reserved capacity setup)

Key milestones (proposed):
- Legal review / redlines (owner: FinTechCo legal)  target complete: 2026-08-25
- Procurement review / PO & approval (owner: FinTechCo procurement)  target complete: 2026-09-05
- Pilot kickoff (owner: Redwood Solutions)  target: 2026-09-07
- Pilot completion / success review (owner: Joint)  target: 2026-09-18
- Contract signature / go-live planning (owner: Joint)  target: 2026-09-20

Dependencies / risks:
- Procurement SLA for PO routing (procurement lead timelines)
- Legal redlines that require commercial review (billing/term changes)
- Reserved capacity provisioning lead time (we estimate 5-7 business days after signature)

Next steps I propose:
1) Please review the MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx and confirm owners/timelines you want to adjust.
2) Share your procurement and legal contact names and any internal deadlines we should be aware of (cc'd Jonas & Ben from our side to help coordinate).
3) If target close Sep 20 is tight for your team, let us know the latest date you can realistically sign and we can adjust milestones accordingly.

Attachment: MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks  happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
+1 (650) 555-0123

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.procurement@fintechco.com>, Kevin Li <kevin.legal@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 16:03:45 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and target close alignment

Thanks Marissa  good summary and thanks for the MAP. Quick responses from our side: 

- Procurement lead: Sarah Patel (cc'd). Our standard procurement window for new vendors is 3-4 weeks for PO routing + approvals once commercial terms are agreed.
- Legal: Kevin Li (cc'd). We'll aim to get legal review completed, but if there are material commercial redlines we may need an extra week.

A couple of clarifying questions: 
1) Is the price in your latest quote valid through Sep 30? We need clarity on price validity for procurement.
2) Can Redwood commit to provisioning reserved capacity within 7 business days after signature? That will determine whether we schedule the pilot to start Sep 7 or push to Sep 14.

Attachment: FinTechCo_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf (procurement checklist)

I think Sep 20 could work but procurement usually needs the contract signed earlier to hit that pilot timeline. Can you update the MAP with a procurement signature deadline and a slightly more conservative pilot start window?

Appreciate it  I put Sarah and Kevin in the loop so they can chime in on internal deadlines.

Best,
Alex
Head of Data & ML, FinTechCo
alex.morgan@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fintechco.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.procurement@fintechco.com>, Kevin Li <kevin.legal@fintechco.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 09:22:10 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and target close alignment

Alex / Sarah / Kevin  thanks for the quick replies and for sharing procurement/legal on this thread. I updated the MAP (attached as MAP_Draft_v3.xlsx) to reflect a procurement signature deadline and a conservative pilot window. Summary of updates below: 

Updated target close: 2026-09-20
Updated procurement / contract signature deadline: 2026-09-15 (we set this earlier than the overall close to ensure 5 business days for provisioning)
Price validity: confirmed  the quote in our system is valid through 2026-09-30 (Jonas will share the exact quote id if needed)
Provisioning SLA: Redwood confirms reserved capacity provisioning within 5 business days of signed order if all payment/PO terms are in place (we include a 7-day buffer in the MAP to be conservative)

Revised milestones & owners: 
- Legal review complete (owner: FinTechCo legal)  target: 2026-08-25
- Commercial finalize & sign-off (owner: FinTechCo procurement + Redwood Sales)  target: 2026-09-10
- Purchase order submitted (owner: FinTechCo procurement)  target: 2026-09-12
- Contract signature (owner: Joint/legal)  target: 2026-09-15
- Provisioning & pilot kickoff (owner: Redwood Solutions)  target window: 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-27

Dependencies called out in the MAP: procurement PO lead time, legal turnaround for redlines, and internal IT review for network/allowlist. Jonas is copied to coordinate technical onboarding and ensure the pilot plan is scoped for the reserved capacity specs. Ben is copied to handle contract/legal questions and speed review where possible.

Requested asks from FinTechCo: 
- Confirm procurement internal deadline(s) and whether Sep 15 is feasible for signature.
- If there are any internal blackout dates or fiscal constraints we should factor into the MAP.

Attachment: MAP_Draft_v3.xlsx (updated)

If everyone is comfortable, I'll sync the MAP to the HubSpot deal and convert these milestones into timeline tasks so we can track completion. Happy to jump on a 20-min call Monday to finalize.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.procurement@fintechco.com>, Kevin Li <kevin.legal@fintechco.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and target close alignment

Marissa  thanks for updating so quickly and for the clarity. Sarah confirmed that a Sep 15 signature is feasible on their end; procurement will aim to have the PO routed by Sep 12. Kevin indicated legal will prioritize the review and try to resolve redlines by Aug 25 as proposed. 

We are aligned  procurement will aim for signature by Sep 10 (earlier if possible), which gives us some buffer. Please go ahead and finalize the MAP in HubSpot and share the link. Also happy to schedule a quick sync early next week to lock the pilot date.

Appreciate the coordination  looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,
Alex
